title: Roguelike Celebration Preview 2023
description:
This year features exclusive fireside chats with David Brevik (Diablo) and Aron Pietroń and Michał Ogłoziński (Against the Storm). We'll also be hosting a talk from Nic Junius titled "Play as in Stage Play: Designing Dynamic Narrative Moments Through Character Acting".

Please note that you cannot comment on Youtube or Twitch; get a free ticket to join us in our self-hosted custom social space in your browser! https://ti.to/roguelike-celebration/preview-event-2023

We have a live captioner, so don't use machine generated closed captions! Check out those captions here:  https://www.streamtext.net/player/?event=RoguelikeCelebration
